skills.description:
This skill handles cross-referencing and data synchronization between a local Excel
logistics tracking file and a Feishu (Lark) spreadsheet. The core workflow: for each
row in the local Excel (identified by 单号 / order number), search the Feishu
tracking sheet for matching records, then fill the corresponding fields (入仓日期,
到港日期, 签收入仓日, 总时效天数, 是否查验, etc.) back into the local Excel.

Triggered when the user says ANY of:
- "物流同步" / "运行物流同步" / "物流跟踪同步"
- "运行 excel-feishu-logistics-sync"
- "用飞书物流跟踪表的数据补齐本地 Excel"
- "根据单号从飞书表格匹配物流信息"
- Mentioning the skill by name or .zip file
The skill auto-loads when triggered — NO manual script invocation needed.
